brique._comment: Engine-native Reflexive family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: read.document
objective.description: Resolve one or more local document descriptors and their reachable content targets.

#root.role: Resolve requested local document items, classify each target as local or external, and return one result entry per requested document.

items._comment: Required non-empty array. Each item: { name (string — document name within the addressed context) }.

total._comment: Total number of items in the result.

result._comment: Per-item result list. Each item on success: { ok: true, name (string), target: { kind (string: 'local'|'ref'), rel (string — path relative to context root, present when kind=local), abs (string — absolute filesystem path, present when kind=local), ref (string — external URI or ref, present when kind=ref) } }. On failure: { ok: false, name, error: { code, message, details: { reason } } }. NOTE: document content bytes are NOT returned inline; the response provides the resolved target path so the caller can read the file directly from the filesystem (abs) or follow the external reference (ref).

effects.document_descriptors: Document descriptors and local document targets may be read from the current context.

transformation_contract.morphing: A list of requested document names becomes a per-item document target result set describing the reachable descriptor and content state for each local document.
invariants: Each requested document contributes one result entry preserving the requested name.
Document resolution is anchored by the descriptor under document/<name>.json; there is no fallback to raw files without a descriptor.
External instance callers are currently refused before any document resolution occurs.
success: On success, total equals the number of returned result entries.
Each successful item returns ok=true and a target describing either a local content pointer or an external reference.
failure: The capacity fails when params.items is missing or empty.
Individual items return ok=false entries when the name is missing, the descriptor is absent or invalid, or the resolved local content path is invalid or missing.
The whole call is refused for external instance callers.
notes: The descriptor must contain brique.file (local pointer) or brique.ref (external reference) to resolve successfully.
Document content bytes are never returned inline; use target.abs to read the file from the filesystem when target.kind is 'local'.
